insight: Backed by ~$218M total funding; its preclinical AI platform is licensed by pharma majors including Sanofi, Merck, and Thermo Fisher.
name: BenchSci
tagline: AI platform for preclinical drug-discovery research.
description: BenchSci builds AI software for preclinical pharmaceutical R&D, helping scientists generate hypotheses, identify targets, and design experiments faster. Its platform reads and structures public scientific literature plus a customer's proprietary data into a Biological Evidence Knowledge Graph that scientists query in natural language. Its newer EMET agentic research environment chains domain-specific scientific tools, alongside the established ASCEND disease-biology platform used across major pharma.

modelSupport.notes: Combines proprietary text- and image-based ML models with LLMs over a curated biological knowledge graph.

edge: Built on a decade-curated Biological Evidence Knowledge Graph of 100M+ papers and figures, not a general LLM bolted onto literature search.
pros: Grounds answers in curated biomedical evidence
Integrates a customer's proprietary internal data
cons: Requires onboarding with a dedicated team

references.title: BenchSci Launches AI Tool to Map Disease Biology for Preclinical Drug Discovery
